question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

The waters of Germany are __abundant__ in fish, but there are few genera and species in them.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"abundant"** means something that exists or is available in large quantities; plentiful. (प्रचुर मात्रा में)

 
 
• **Example: **During the harvest season, the fields are **abundant** with crops.
 
 
 
• **"Deficient"** refers to something that is lacking in some necessary quality or element; not enough. (अपर्याप्त)
 
 
• **Example: **The soil in the region is **deficient** in nutrients, which affects crop yield.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'abundant'** is **'deficient'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Flourish** (फलना-फूलना): Grow or develop in a healthy or vigorous way.

 
 
• **Example:** The business continued to **flourish **despite the economic downturn.
 
 
 
• **Allay** (कम करना): Diminish or put at rest (fear, suspicion, or worry).
 
 
• **Example:** The government aimed to **allay** public fears through transparent communication.
 
 
 
• **Discord** (विवाद): Disagreement between people.
 
 
• **Example:** The** discord** among the team members affected their performance.
